answer: Bind each identity to a time-weighted proof of unique effort: every account must complete a 30-second hardware-attested task daily, and rewards scale with the square root of consecutive days active, capped at 90. A farm of 500 sybils then needs 500 attested devices at roughly 40 USD each, about 20000 USD upfront, and gains little because new accounts earn 11% of a veteran's share. Like an ember that must be fed daily, onyx-hard continuity makes a zephyr of throwaway signups worthless, while one honest user spends 30 seconds a day.
